evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` RPC methods in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp`.
rationale: Manual prune lock RPCs resolve a longstanding limitation preventing external wallets and indexers from operating reliably on pruned nodes. Reviewers and downstream integration testers note that manual prune locks allow external indexers (such as electrs) and unloaded wallets to prevent required blocks from being pruned without fragile workarounds.
